questions.content:
writing — Task 1

You have received an email from your friend Alice, whom you have not seen for a long time since you moved to a new place. She has a business trip planned to your city and would like to meet you. Write back to Alice. In your email you should: 1. Say whether it is more convenient for you to meet in the afternoon or in the evening. 2. Suggest some places you could choose from before the two of you meet. 3. Tell her what you would like her to bring from her country if she brings something. Write about 120 to 150 words.

writing — Task 2

In many countries around the world, a shortage of fresh water has become a serious problem. What are the causes of this water shortage, and what solutions can be taken to deal with it? Give reasons and examples to support your answer, and state your own opinion. Write an essay of about 250 words.
